meta.title: Master Director Styles
meta.purpose: Abstracted signatures (narrative + visual) the system can borrow from — never copying, only transferring decision patterns.
meta.note: Style profiles are Level 2-3 abstractions of publicly discussed authorial signatures.

directors.name: Pixar (studio)
directors.narrative: universal emotional cores, clear wants, wordless visual storytelling, bittersweet turns
directors.visual: warm painterly lighting, tactile surfaces, expressive character acting, staged depth
directors.camera: motivated moves, restrained; lets performance lead
directors.color: warm nostalgic palettes, emotional color scripts
themes: what it means to be alive

directors.name: Walt Disney Animation
directors.narrative: fairy-tale arcs, transformation, musical structure, hope
directors.visual: graphic clarity, iconic silhouettes, expressive color, hand-crafted texture (e.g. Paperman 2D-on-3D)
directors.color: bold, symbolic, high emotional saturation (or B&W + single accent)

directors.name: Hayao Miyazaki / Studio Ghibli
directors.visual: lush natural detail, soft light, hand-drawn warmth, quiet wide shots

directors.name: Wes Anderson
directors.narrative: deadpan melancholy, chaptered structure, ensemble whimsy
directors.visual: perfect central symmetry, flat frontal staging, dollhouse worlds
directors.camera: whip pans, snap zooms, planimetric locked frames
directors.color: curated pastel palettes, per-film signature scheme

directors.name: Bong Joon-ho
directors.narrative: genre-blending, class satire, tonal whiplash, precise reversals
directors.visual: meticulous staging, vertical/spatial metaphor, storyboarded to the frame
directors.camera: controlled, geometric, motivated moves; famous rigorous boards

directors.name: Ridley Scott
directors.narrative: world-first immersion, mythic scope, atmosphere over exposition
directors.visual: painterly detailed storyboards ('Ridleygrams'), smoke/haze, layered light shafts
directors.camera: multi-camera coverage, epic wides, textured close detail

directors.name: James Cameron
directors.visual: kinetic action geometry, immersive scale, spectacle with clarity
directors.camera: dynamic tracking, crash energy, immersive rigs
directors.color: cool tech blues vs. warm human tones

directors.name: Tim Burton
directors.narrative: gothic fairy tale, outsider heroes, whimsical melancholy
directors.visual: expressionist spirals, exaggerated silhouettes, storybook decay
directors.color: desaturated gothic + candy accents; German Expressionist contrast

directors.name: Denis Villeneuve
directors.visual: monumental negative space, fog, silhouettes against immensity
directors.color: monochrome washes (amber, slate, teal), tonal blocks
